description: Source code for the Intel IBECC EDAC driver in Zephyr OS, handling ECC error logging, error injection, and NMI processing.

methods.name: ibecc_write_reg64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to a specified register offset in the device's memory-mapped I/O space.

methods.name: ibecc_read_reg64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from a specified register offset in the device's memory-mapped I/O space.

methods.name: ibecc_enabled
methods.description: Checks if IBECC is enabled for a given PCIe BDF.

methods.name: ibecc_errcmd_setup
methods.description: Configures error command register to enable or disable error reporting.

methods.name: ibecc_errsts_clear
methods.description: Clears error status bits in PCIe configuration space.

methods.name: parse_ecclog
methods.description: Parses ECC error log register and updates error data and counts.

methods.name: inject_set_param1
methods.description: Sets the injection address base register.

methods.name: inject_get_param1
methods.description: Gets the injection address base register value.

methods.name: inject_set_param2
methods.description: Sets the injection address mask register.

methods.name: inject_get_param2
methods.description: Gets the injection address mask register value.

methods.name: inject_set_error_type
methods.description: Sets the current error type for injection.

methods.name: inject_get_error_type
methods.description: Retrieves the current error type for injection.

methods.name: inject_error_trigger
methods.description: Triggers an error injection based on the set error type.

methods.name: ecc_error_log_get
methods.description: Retrieves ECC error log register value if errors are present.

methods.name: ecc_error_log_clear
methods.description: Clears ECC error log register.

methods.name: parity_error_log_get
methods.description: Retrieves parity error log register value if errors are present.

methods.name: parity_error_log_clear
methods.description: Clears parity error log register.

methods.name: errors_cor_get
methods.description: Returns count of correctable errors.

methods.name: errors_uc_get
methods.description: Returns count of uncorrectable errors.

methods.name: notify_callback_set
methods.description: Sets callback function for error notification.

methods.name: edac_ibecc_init
methods.description: Initializes the IBECC driver, maps MCHBAR, and enables error reporting.

methods.name: z_x86_do_kernel_nmi
methods.description: Handles NMI for ECC errors, logs errors, and invokes callback.
